detail.title: 保压机构及具有该机构的压装机
detail.abstract: A pressure maintaining mechanism comprises a force application member, a pressure receiving member, a tension member, an elastic member and a pressure member, wherein the pressure receiving member is connected with the force application member, and the tension member is arranged above the pressure receiving member. One end of the elastic part is connected with the compression part, and the other end of the elastic part is connected with the tension part and used for uniformly pulling the tension part. The pressing piece is used for pressing the material to the workpiece along a first direction. A press-mounting machine is used for pressing a material onto the surface of a workpiece and comprises a pressing head and the pressure maintaining mechanism, wherein a force application part is used for being connected with the pressing head, and the pressing part is used for pressing the material onto the surface of the workpiece. The pressure maintaining mechanism and the press-mounting machine apply pressure to the pressure receiving piece through the force application piece, and the pressure receiving piece uniformly pulls the tension receiving piece through the elastic piece, so that the tension receiving piece uniformly presses the material to the workpiece through the pressing piece, and the purposes of completely laminating the material and the workpiece and ensuring the pressure maintaining effect are achieved.
